comparison.objective: Lever up a crate, insert dunnage beneath it, and lower the crate onto the block.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load support and block insertion under a raised mass; it does not require precision impact tooling or small-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Crate rests on inserted dunnage after the lever is released. Numeric limits and detailed failure rubric are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both use two arms and force control, this tests temporary lifting and support insertion rather than notch fracture and containment.
